# CodeAlpha Tasks – Full Stack Development
Internship: CodeAlpha | Student: Thangamani B | ID: CA/DF1/434207

Four full stack projects (Node.js + Express backend, HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend, JWT login, JSON-file database).

| Task | Project | Features |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | E-commerce Store | Register/Login, product list, cart, checkout, order history |
| 2 | Social Media App | Posts, likes, comments, follow/unfollow, feed |
| 3 | Project Management Tool | Projects, tasks, To-do/Doing/Done board, assign tasks |
| 4 | Chat App | Login, multiple rooms, auto-refreshing messages |

## Run
```
npm install
npm start
```
Open http://localhost:3000

## Tech
Node.js, Express, JWT (jsonwebtoken), bcryptjs, vanilla JS.
